question: For each instance display name, show the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (in MB) across that display name, considering only instances that have a matching row in INSTANCE_EXTRA, are in availability zone 'flare3', and whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime'. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT i.display_name,
       MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS range,
       VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance,
       STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS stddev
FROM instances i
JOIN instance_extra ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
  AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
